The '''battle on Dakot Seven''' was a small-scale conflict that saw the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Arn Peralun]] and [[Arn Peralun's master|his master]] attempt to defend the native population from [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. But incoming fire from the slavers killed his master while Peralun received serious injuries. But the native people were able to provide him with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic replacements]] in order to keep him alive since the natives did not use neither [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] or [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="TOR-TUC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Arn Peralun}}</ref>
